nodes.summary: A $1$-Lipschitz function on $[a,b]$ is absolutely continuous with essentially bounded derivative. Let $a \le b$ be real numbers and let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfy $|f(x) - f(y)| \le |x - y|$ for all $x, y \in [a, b]$. Then $f$ is absolutely continuous on $[a, b]$, and its derivative $f'$, taken to be $0$ at points where $f$ is not differentiable, has finite norm $\|f'\|_{L^\infty[a,b]}$, the essential…
nodes.title: A $1$-Lipschitz function on $(a,b)$ is absolutely continuous with essentially bounded derivative

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ and let $M \ge 0$ be a real number. Then $|f(x) - f(y)| \le M|x - y|$ for all $x, y \in \mathbb{R}$ if and only if $f$ is absolutely continuous on every closed bounded interval and $|f'(x)| \le M$ for almost every $x \in \mathbb{R}$ (with respect to Lebesgue measure), where $f'(x)$ is taken to be $0$ at points where $f$ is not differentiable.
nodes.title: Lipschitz functions are the absolutely continuous functions with bounded derivative

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be absolutely continuous on every closed bounded interval $[a, b]$. Then $f$ maps Lebesgue null sets to null sets: for every set $s \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ of Lebesgue outer measure zero, the image $f(s)$ has Lebesgue outer measure zero.
nodes.title: Absolutely continuous functions have the Lusin N property
